notes: REF-BM-02: metadata collects title/summary/siteName only; no favicon or preview image fetched. REF-BM-03: title/summary editable after save, but no before-save edit step (URL is saved immediately). REF-BM-04: title/summary/note/tags editable, but URL cannot be edited (PATCH ignores url). REF-BM-07: cards show title/summary/tags but use a first-letter tile, not an actual favicon. REF-BM-10: tag entry is a plain comma input with no existing-tag autocomplete/datalist. REF-BM-14: search is plain substring over joined fields; '#tag' is treated literally, no tag syntax. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-20: no multi-select UI or bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no filter-wide bulk apply. REF-BM-22: list is hardcoded to date-added desc; no sort-key selection. REF-BM-23: note stored/displayed as plain text (textContent), not rendered markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot or Internet Archive feature. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no user display settings (sort/items/font size).
